presentationProfile.title: Outrank
presentationProfile.description: Automate SEO content creation, keyword research, article generation, and Search Console monitoring with Outrank

bulkDeleteKeywords.description: Deletes multiple target keywords from a product in a single request

bulkProcessKeywords.description: Processes or queues multiple keywords for generation and scheduling simultaneously

bulkReplaceArticles.description: Replaces content across multiple articles in a batch operation

bulkRescheduleKeywords.description: Updates publishing and generation schedule times for multiple keywords in batch

connectSearchConsole.description: Initiates or updates the Google Search Console integration for a product

createProduct.description: Creates and configures a new product or website tracking record

exportKeywords.description: Exports keyword metrics and scheduling datasets for a specific product

generateArticle.description: Generates a full SEO-optimized article based on a target keyword ID

generateKeywords.description: Generates new AI SEO keyword clusters and ideas for a product

getArticle.description: Retrieves metadata, SEO metrics, and publication status for a specific article

getArticleContent.description: Retrieves the rendered body text and content of an article in the requested format

getBillingPortalUrl.description: Generates a secure session URL for managing subscriptions in customer billing

getCurrentIdentity.description: Returns the user, organization, and remaining article credits associated with the key.

getProduct.description: Retrieves configuration, settings, and metadata for a specific product by ID

getSearchConsoleCannibalization.description: Identifies competing pages ranking for identical search terms via Search Console

getSearchConsoleConnection.description: Retrieves connection details and status for Google Search Console on a product

getSearchConsolePerformance.description: Retrieves organic search impressions, clicks, CTR, and keyword rankings over a period

getSubscriptionStatus.description: Retrieves active plan details and subscription status for the organization

getUsageStats.description: Retrieves generation statistics, consumed credits, and feature usage totals

inspectSearchConsoleUrl.description: Inspects Google indexation and crawl status for a specific URL on the product.

listArticles.description: Retrieves a paginated list of generated articles filtered by product, status, or keyword

listKeywords.description: Retrieves keywords filtered by product ID, search volume, difficulty, and scheduling windows

listProducts.description: Retrieves a paginated list of websites or products configured under the organization

pauseProduct.description: Pauses automatic keyword tracking and article scheduling for a product

precreateArticle.description: Creates an article outline or draft container for a keyword before generation

purchaseProducts.description: The official CLI sends a quote request without confirm_charge_cents, then sends a confirmed purchase with that value and an idempotency key.

replaceArticle.description: Overwrites or regenerates the content of an existing article

resumeProduct.description: Resumes automatic keyword scheduling and article publishing for a paused product

retryArticlePublish.description: Retries publishing an article to connected CMS integrations after an earlier failure

suggestKeywords.description: Suggests related topic keywords and expansion opportunities for a product

updateProduct.description: Updates the settings, tracking details, or configuration of an existing product
